npmDependencyClassification: Transitive production dependency (dev flag absent), even though this deployment uses Astro as a static build tool.

advisory.summary: Reported shared-cache cross-user disclosure when a client max-stale directive permits reuse of a response carrying another user’s Set-Cookie.

fixStatus.note: 4.3.0 is outside the current audit range and satisfies Astro ^4.2.0, but the official advisory has no first patched version. Clearing this audit warning is not evidence the disputed behavior was fixed. No dependency update was attempted.

dispute.maintainerPosition: Maintainer disputes the Set-Cookie-based claim and closed the report as not planned on 2026-10-04.
dispute.caution: The advisory remains active. A separate discussion identifies revalidation-directive concerns; no patch or blanket false-positive conclusion is claimed here.

observed: Exact-source astro.config.mjs sets output: static and has no SSR adapter.
Exact-source wrangler.jsonc has only an assets directory and no main script entry.
Exact-source package-lock blob matches the audited immutable lockfile.
exposureAssessment.inference: For this asset-only deployment, Astro and this Node dependency are build tooling rather than request-handling code in the deployed Worker. The reported shared Node cache/session-reuse path is therefore not indicated by the inspected deployment configuration.
exposureAssessment.uncertainty: This audit did not re-download the deployed artifact, inspect Cloudflare platform internals, or reproduce an exploit. It does not certify the entire site or build environment as vulnerability-free. A future SSR, proxy or shared application cache would require a new exposure assessment.

actionsTaken: Run npm audit --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --json on exact copied inputs.
Read official npm registry and GitHub advisory/maintainer records.
workspaceNote: Executor transport interruption restored an older workspace and removed the prior release directory. Only dependency-audit inputs/evidence were recreated from immutable GitHub blobs; original local source was not recreated or edited.
